source: CAMIL GE-V-04 · Page 08 · Health and Colors (colours half)
notes: The second half of page 08, split off: colours and health share a page and nothing else.
'BLOND(E)' normalised to 'blond'. 'GREY' normalised to 'gray' — the page uses American
spelling everywhere else, including 'colors' in its own title.
violet/purple are the violeta/morado pair and stay in one unit.
'mourning' is not a colour, but the page groups it with black and it is genuinely useful.
Note for later pages: 'mourning' and 'morning' are homophones. They are in different
areas so no exercise can mix them, but a time-and-date page should not reuse this word.
VERY_EASY: an A1/A2 course, still its early pages.
